name: frpm
definition: 按学年记录某所学校学生规模与免费/减价餐资格人数的统计信息条目。 Counterexample: 与学校主数据（schools）区分：本对象是逐年统计记录，学校主数据是相对稳定的机构档案；同一学校可有多个学年记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table frpm; provenance: direct source frpm
aliases: 免费及减价餐统计记录

name: satscores
definition: 按学校（cds）汇总的 SAT 参考人数与各科平均分及达标人数的考试成绩统计信息条目。 Counterexample: 与 frpm 区分：本对象度量考试表现，frpm 度量餐费资格与经济指标；两者均以学校为粒度但指标不同。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table satscores; provenance: direct source satscores

name: schools
definition: 以 CDSCode 唯一标识的、具有名称、地址、联系方式与开办/关闭日期的教育机构。 Counterexample: 与 frpm、satscores 区分：本对象是机构实体，后两者是关于该机构的统计信息记录；与学区（District）区分：学区是学校的上级管理单位，本对象是具体办学点。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table schools; provenance: direct source schools

name: EligibleFreeRate
definition: Percentage of students eligible for free meals.

name: FRPMCount
definition: Number of students eligible for free or reduced price meals.
aliases: free or reduced price meal count

name: FRPMRate
definition: Proportion of students eligible for free or reduced price meals.
aliases: eligible free or reduced price meal rate
free or reduced price meal rate

name: VirtualSchool
definition: A school that does not offer a physical building (virtual).

name: ElementarySchoolDistrict
definition: A school district that is an elementary school district.

name: UnifiedSchoolDistrict
definition: A school district that is a unified school district.

name: ReadingScore
definition: Average SAT reading score.

name: MathScore
definition: Average SAT math score.

name: WritingScore
definition: Average SAT writing score.

name: EnrollmentK12
definition: Enrollment count for grades K-12.

name: EnrollmentAges5To17
definition: Enrollment count for ages 5-17.

name: PhoneNumber
definition: School's phone number.

name: StreetAddress
definition: School's street address.

name: FundingType
definition: Type of funding for the school.

name: OpenDate
definition: Date the school opened.

name: ClosedDate
definition: Date the school closed.

name: AverageMathScore
definition: Average of SAT math scores across schools. Formula: AVG(AvgScrMath). Inputs: MathScore = satscores.AvgScrMath

name: AverageReadingScore
definition: Average of SAT reading scores across schools. Formula: AVG(AvgScrRead). Inputs: ReadingScore = satscores.AvgScrRead

name: AverageWritingScore
definition: Average of SAT writing scores across schools. Formula: AVG(AvgScrWrite). Inputs: WritingScore = satscores.AvgScrWrite

name: RatioUnifiedToElementary
definition: Ratio of the number of unified school districts to elementary school districts. Formula: COUNT(UnifiedSchoolDistrict) / COUNT(ElementarySchoolDistrict). Inputs: UnifiedSchoolDistrict = schools.DOC WHERE DOC = '54'; ElementarySchoolDistrict = schools.DOC WHERE DOC = '52'
